name: Control: the same strict read from the local instance store (expected to be refused on Nitro NVMe)

tasks.name: one file per GPU on /local
commands: mkdir -p /local/gdsio; NG=$(nvidia-smi -L | wc -l); for g in $(seq 0 $((NG-1))); do [ -f /local/gdsio/f$g ] || dd if=/dev/urandom of=/local/gdsio/f$g bs=16M count=256 oflag=direct status=none & done; wait

tasks.name: strict vs compat vs CPU staging on /local, one and eight GPUs
commands: dmesg -T | grep -iE 'nvme|nvidia-fs|I/O Error' | tail -100 | tee $OUT/logs-raw-local-dmesg.txt || true
